verdict.rationale: Babylon.js is scripted in JavaScript/TypeScript with documented full IntelliSense (docs-12), API typedocs (docs-3), modular ES6 packages, and an interactive Playground editor. A community user confirms the TypeScript integration works well (comm-15), and others praise the API's clarity and documentation. For debugging, the product ships a first-party Inspector for runtime debugging and scene analysis (docs-13, docs-20), and Spector provides WebGL-level debugging (comm-10). missing for 10: a documented first-party script-level debugger (breakpoints/stepping) rather than scene/GPU inspection, explicit evidence that the full engine API is exposed to scripts (currently implied by the typedocs), and hands-on corroboration of the debugging workflow.
